rv.q: Puccini’s melodies soared, and prayers were sung above a perfectly balanced and paced performance laden with emotion.

Some casts manage to breathe new life into the production while others seem to go through the motions, hoping that Puccini's music will suffice. Fortunately, the Met Opera's current cast, which opened the revival on Oct. 21, 2025, is the former and might just be the best I have seen in quite some time.
